requirement: The AI helpers stay off unless the server has both switches
expected: Without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and LARIA_AI_HELPERS=1, no page shows Pregúntale a tu tienda or Completar con IA, and both routes answer 404 before reading the request.
preconditions: Server without one or both variables
steps: Open Mi tienda, Inventario and Publicar; POST to /api/store/ask and /api/listing-assist.

requirement: A production build never answers with the local fake
expected: With LARIA_AI_FAKE set, a production build refuses to start; under next dev without it, the real client is used.
steps: Run pnpm build with LARIA_AI_FAKE=1, then without it.

requirement: Every AI request is structured output with an effort and server-side fallback where it exists
expected: Requests carry output_config.format and output_config.effort, no thinking or sampling fields; Opus, Sonnet 5.5 and Fable 5.1 send fallbacks default with its beta, Haiku 5.5 does not.
steps: Inspect the requests built for both helpers.

requirement: A refusal or an incomplete answer never becomes a suggestion
expected: stop_reason refusal is read before any content and answers 422 with a way forward; max_tokens or unparsable JSON is logged as invalid and answers 503.
preconditions: Fake client returning a refusal, a cut-off answer and bad JSON
steps: Ask a question and run Completar con IA against each.

requirement: Daily limits are enforced before any AI call
expected: The 51st question of a store in a day, the 21st photo assist of an account, and any call over LARIA_AI_DAILY_CAP are refused with the reset time (7 p. m. in Lima) and no AI call; a counter that can't count refuses too.
preconditions: Store and account near their limits
steps: Ask questions and run photo assists past each limit.

requirement: Each AI call is logged without its content
expected: One row per call that reached the API with feature, account, store, model, tokens and outcome; no question, photo or answer is stored; only the service role writes it and no API role reads it.
steps: Make calls with each outcome; read laria_private.ai_requests as each role.

requirement: The AI log follows retention and account anonymization
expected: Rows older than 90 days are deleted by ai-request-retention; an anonymized account's rows lose the account at once, and a call written after the anonymization has no account.
preconditions: Log rows of an account and old rows

requirement: A store question opens existing Inventario filters
expected: ¿qué guitarras tengo con menos de 2 unidades? opens Inventario with Guitarras, Stock bajo and the least available first, and Así lo entendí says there is no filter by number of units.
steps: Ask the question in Pregúntale a tu tienda.

requirement: A store question can open Estadísticas or Reposición
expected: ¿qué es lo más visto esta semana? opens Estadísticas for 7 days at Lo más visto; ¿qué vendí más este mes? opens Reposición and says sales and dates have no filter.

requirement: The store's data never goes to the AI service
expected: The request to the model holds only the question and the filter vocabulary; no SKU, stock, price or statistic.
steps: Ask a question; inspect the request.

requirement: An answer outside the site's lists never becomes a link
expected: A destination, filter, period or section outside the site's lists makes the answer invalid; the search text is cleaned and cut to 60 characters.
steps: Ask a question against each bad answer.

requirement: Así lo entendí lets the owner adjust what was used
expected: Each filter used is a chip that removes it and keeps the panel; Cerrar leaves the filters and hides the panel; a question with nothing to filter says so with examples.
steps: Remove a chip; press Cerrar; ask about something unrelated.

requirement: Pregúntale a tu tienda is only for stores with Inventario
expected: A Particular, a store without Inventario or a signed-out visitor gets no box and the route refuses before any AI call.
preconditions: Accounts of each kind, helpers on

requirement: Completar con IA sends only small JPEGs, only when tapped
expected: Nothing is sent until the button is tapped; then up to four JPEGs of at most 1024 px and 600 KB, without metadata; the route refuses anything else before any AI call.
preconditions: Sell form with photos, helpers on
steps: Add photos; watch the network; tap Completar con IA; POST other files to the route.

requirement: Suggestions follow the site's registries and never cover condition, price or specs
expected: Category and type come from the registries (a type of another category is dropped); brand, model, title, details and description are cut to the form's sizes; no condition, price or specifications are proposed.
steps: Run Completar con IA against each answer.

requirement: Usar todo never overwrites what the seller wrote nor names another instrument
expected: Usar todo fills only empty fields and names the ones it left; a filled field shows Reemplazar with Ahora: …; with a brand or model of the seller's own that differs, Usar todo also holds the model, title and description; brand and model rewrite the title only while the form still writes it.
preconditions: Sell form with some fields typed
steps: Run Completar con IA; press Usar todo; then Reemplazar on one row.

requirement: Details go into the description without losing the seller's text
expected: Agregar a la descripción puts a Detalles list below the seller's text and above a store's standard text; using the description later keeps the list.
preconditions: Store with a standard description text
steps: Add the details, then use the suggested description.

requirement: Photos that show no instrument get an honest answer
expected: When the photos show no instrument or audio gear, the form says so and suggests a clearer photo; a low-confidence answer warns to check each field.
preconditions: Fake client returning recognized false, then low confidence

requirement: The helpers' screens pass accessibility checks
expected: The question box, Así lo entendí and the suggestion rows pass axe (WCAG 2.2 AA) at phone and desktop width, with labels on every button.
preconditions: Helpers on with the fake client
steps: Run the axe pass on Inventario after a question and on the sell form with suggestions.
